body:
## Pull request overview This PR fixes two related filter-chain behaviors in NVFlare’s messaging pipeline: (1) job-configured task filters now honor executor-style `*` task patterns with exact task names taking precedence, and (2) `DXOFilter` now invokes `process_dxo` even for empty leaf DXOs so initialization-style filters can populate data. It also updates several data-dependent filters to safely skip empty input, documents the behavior, and adds regression tests. **Changes:** - Add wildcard (`*`) task-pattern matching to `apply_filters` configuration lookup, preferring exact task matches. - Adjust `DXOFilter` to call `process_dxo` for matching leaf DXOs even when their data is empty. - Add/extend tests and documentation covering wildcard task filters and empty-DXO behavior, and update several filters to skip empty DXO data safely. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 17 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
